map.Conceptual: a solution is the value that: Conceptual: a solution is the value that makes an equation TRUE. Substitute the key for x. Then check if both sides are equal.

map.Practice beam: n + 3 = 10. Lift 3 off BO: Practice beam: n + 3 = 10. Take 3 off BOTH pans… n = 7. It never shook.
